name: kubiq-web-panels
description: Reference for web panels in Kubiq — adding a new web-driven editor or viewer that runs somebody else's component over the interface's own loopback origin. The tenant id, the bridge frames, the chrome page and its CSP, the hash-verified vendor mirror, and how a tenant is wired into a ViewerKind. Use when adding a web panel tenant, touching web_export, the bridge, assets/web/, the web_assets bundle fetch, or the Edit layout of a viewer.
